title: BirdsBirdBirds
tagline: Draw a bird, then direct its flight by talking to Pi.
learning_objectives: describing a task so an agent can do it
refining an agent's work one prompt at a time
checking an agent's work with a script

steps.title: Draw your bird
steps.hint: Draw a bird on the page and press Save my bird.
steps.done_when: The file bird.png exists in the workspace.

steps.title: Teach it to fly
steps.hint: Tell Pi how your bird should fly, like you'd tell a friend.
steps.done_when: Pi wrote bird.json from the participant's description and it passes check-bird.mjs.

steps.title: Direct the flight
steps.hint: Tell Pi what to change. Name a waypoint number to change just that part.
steps.done_when: Two or more distinct flights have passed check-bird.mjs (.flights holds 2 or more files), or the participant says they're happy with the flight.

steps.title: Join the flock
steps.hint: Say you're happy with the flight, and Pi sends your bird to the booth screens.
steps.done_when: Pi called publish_gallery_item with the bird and got an answer, whatever its outcome.
